description: Synthetic ride, airport-pickup and ledger fixture for package validation; not an evaluation task.

sources.description: Metro Ashford places, zones, travel times, supply, flights, drivers, vehicles, payment methods and ride histories written by the seeded generator. All people, places, drivers, plates, flights and prices are fictional; no real ride, fare or location data is collected.

transformations: All times are RFC 3339 with UTC offsets in the place's IANA time zone; money is integer cents in USD.

review.notes: Automatic checks do not replace human review of realism, wording and provenance.
